assumptions.statement: All spatial metrics and geometries in this package are based on the provisional boundaries (brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson), not on an official redline.
assumptions.impact: Every area, ratio, and boundary-derived figure must be recalculated once the official boundary polygon is released; provisional values must not be used for statutory, approval, or official area-recalculation purposes.

assumptions.statement: Official values for FAR (floor area ratio), building height, building density, green ratio, and setbacks are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity proposals are conceptual references only; official control values must be confirmed from the qualification document attachments before statutory use. Supersedes the scaffold assumption A-CONTROLS-001 for regulatory controls.

assumptions.statement: Parcel-level ownership data is not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish (拆改留) proposals are conceptual; actual parcel ownership must be confirmed before any implementation decision.

assumptions.statement: The official precise boundary is not publicly available as of 2026-08-07.
assumptions.impact: The package therefore relies on provisional boundary geometry; replace with the official redline and recalculate all metrics before professional scoring. This data gap does not block content review.

assumptions.statement: The interplanetary civilization dialogue concept (SETI data nodes, public radio observatory terrace, interstellar information sculpture park, cross-civilization dialogue forum) is a cultural and spatial proposal, not a claim of any confirmed interstellar communication.
assumptions.impact: It must be treated as a conceptual design feature; scientific content requires astronomer review and any physical installation requires professional feasibility study before implementation.

assumptions.statement: All AI service descriptions (AI health stations, AI education pods, AI legal terminals, robot delivery lockers, AI concierge multi-agent system, urban sensing layer) are conceptual.
assumptions.impact: Each service requires professional system design, security review, and regulatory compliance (e.g., Generative AI interim measures) before implementation; the proposal is a design concept, not an implementation plan.
